title: H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning
abstract: Long-horizon planning with latent world models requires reasoning across timescales and levels of abstraction. Existing task-agnostic JEPA world models predict and plan at a single timescale or with multiple horizons in one shared latent space. We introduce H-JEPA, an end-to-end recipe for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPAs in which each level predicts farther ahead in its own learned latent space. Planning proceeds top-down: the top level optimizes progress toward the goal, and each level's predictions become subgoals for the planner below it. When factors in the data evolve at separated timescales, higher levels discard fast, unpredictable detail and retain slower task-relevant state. Across four simulated navigation and manipulation environments, hierarchical planning improves over a flat JEPA; on Visual AntMaze, a three-level hierarchy raises success from 18% to 73% using less planner compute. Ablations attribute these gains to both temporal decomposition and higher-level goal representations. With inverse-dynamics supervision, the approach extends to diverse real-robot videos from DROID, where hierarchy improves offline planning fidelity at lower planner compute.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a hypothetical course called Model-Based Planning and World Models, today’s lecture is on Aitch-jepa: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning. Recent work such as Ada jepa: An Adaptive Latent World Model and Hierarchical Planning with Latent World Models reflects a growing interest in planning with learned visual dynamics. This paper, from researchers including New York University and Brown University, asks how those dynamics can be organized across time. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在一门假设叫《基于模型的规划与世界模型》的课上，今天讲的是Aitch-jepa：面向视觉规划的端到端分层世界模型学习。最近的一些工作，比如Ada jepa：一种自适应潜在世界模型，以及用潜在世界模型做分层规划，都反映出大家对用学到的视觉动态来做规划越来越感兴趣。这篇论文来自包括纽约大学和布朗大学在内的研究者，它问的是：这些动态该怎么在时间上组织起来。诺亚，你有什么问题？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, why does planning need a hierarchy instead of one good predictive model?
segments.zh: 教授您好，为什么规划需要一个层级结构，而不是一个足够好的预测模型就够了？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A flat model predicts one step at a time, so long plans require many predictions and many action choices. Errors can build up, and the planner’s work grows with the horizon. A single representation must also capture immediate motion details and support judging progress toward a more abstract goal. A hierarchy offers a way to distribute these demands: lower levels handle near-term changes, while upper levels predict farther ahead and can emphasize slower-changing information.
segments.zh: 扁平模型一次只预测一步，所以长规划需要很多次预测和很多动作选择。误差会累积，规划器的工作量也随规划长度增长。单一表示还必须同时捕捉即时运动细节，并支持判断朝更抽象目标推进的进展。分层提供了一种分散这些需求的方式：低层处理近期变化，高层预测更远的未来，并能侧重变化更慢的信息。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the upper levels are meant to ignore details that do not matter for the goal?
segments.zh: 所以上层就是要有意忽略那些对目标无关紧要的细节吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is the intended effect, but it is learned rather than imposed as a hand-designed abstraction. Aitch-jepa trains a stack of action-conditioned predictors from observation and action trajectories. Each level predicts future representations in its own latent space, rather than reconstructing image pixels. Higher levels summarize lower-level states and actions over longer intervals. The authors ask whether this structure yields useful temporal abstraction and whether it makes goal-directed planning more efficient.
segments.zh: 这正是设计意图，不过这种抽象是学出来的，而不是人为硬性规定的。Aitch-jepa 用观测和动作轨迹训练了一堆以动作为条件的预测器。每一层都在自己的潜空间里预测未来的表示，而不是重建图像像素。更高层则对更长时间跨度内较低层的状态和动作进行总结。作者想探究的是，这种结构能否带来有用的时间抽象，以及它是否能让目标导向的规划更高效。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: does every level share the same representation, as in the hierarchical world model?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：是不是每一层都共享同一个表示，就像分层世界模型那样？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. The distinction is central: the hierarchical world model decomposes planning over time while retaining a shared latent space, whereas aitch-jepa learns a separate space at each level. Each higher level has its own encoder and predictor, and its steps span a longer interval. In the simulated settings, adjacent levels typically double the prediction interval; the real-robot dataset uses a stride of 3 at its second level. This gives the hierarchy both temporal and representational structure.
segments.zh: 不是。这个区别很关键：分层世界模型是在时间上分解规划，同时保留一个共享的潜空间，而aitch-jepa则在每一层学习各自独立的潜空间。每个更高层都有自己的编码器和预测器，而且它的步长覆盖更长的时间间隔。在仿真设置中，相邻层通常把预测间隔翻倍；真实机器人数据集在第二层用了3的步幅。这让整个层级结构同时具备时间结构和表征结构。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Training is end-to-end. A level compares its predicted future state with an encoded future state, and an isotropic-distribution regularizer helps prevent all embeddings from collapsing to the same value. Because upper-level losses can update lower-level encoders, the representations are not learned in isolation. The method uses action-labelled trajectories, but it does not need reward labels or an image-reconstruction objective. That distinction matters when learning from recorded behavior rather than task-specific feedback.
segments.zh: 训练是端到端的。每一层会把预测的未来状态和编码后的未来状态做比较，同时用一个各向同性分布的正则项来防止所有嵌入都塌缩到同一个值。由于上层的损失可以更新下层的编码器，所以这些表示并不是孤立地学出来的。这个方法用的是带动作标注的轨迹，但不需要奖励标签，也不需要图像重建目标。当我们要从录制的行为中学习、而不是依赖特定任务的反馈时，这个区别就很关键。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does the hierarchy turn those predictions into actual plans?
segments.zh: 这个层级结构是如何把这些预测变成实际计划的？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Planning starts at the top. The highest-level planner searches for macro-actions that move its predicted state toward the goal observation. Those predicted states become subgoals for the level below, which selects actions to reach them. This continues down to primitive actions. Each lower-level plan is assessed in the representation of the level above, allowing the planner to compare progress at different temporal resolutions. Candidate action sequences are optimized by gradient descent through the learned predictors.
segments.zh: 规划从最顶层开始。最高层的规划器搜索宏动作，让预测状态朝着目标观测推进。这些预测状态会成为下一层的子目标，下一层再选择动作去达成它们。这样一直往下，直到最底层的原始动作。每个低层的规划都会在上一层的表示空间里被评估，这样规划器就能在不同时间尺度上比较进展。候选动作序列则通过在学习到的预测器上做梯度下降来优化。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify why comparing progress in an upper-level space could help if the action rollout is unchanged?
segments.zh: 如果动作轨迹没变，为什么在上层空间里比较进度会有帮助，你能解释一下吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A high-level representation may measure task progress more appropriately than a detailed low-level one. Imagine navigating a maze: the agent’s location and the maze layout matter, while the exact position of each limb may not. The authors test this idea by keeping a flat rollout but scoring its predicted states in an upper-level representation. That isolates the goal-matching benefit of abstraction from the separate benefit of breaking a long plan into shorter subgoal problems.
segments.zh: 高层表示可能比细节丰富的低层表示更适合衡量任务进度。想象一下走迷宫：智能体的位置和迷宫布局很重要，而每条肢体具体摆在哪可能并不重要。作者通过保留扁平轨迹、但用高层表示来给预测状态打分，验证了这一想法。这样就把抽象带来的目标匹配收益，与把长计划拆成更短子目标问题所带来的另一层收益区分开了。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The experiments cover navigation in FourRoomDistractors and Visual AntMaze, and manipulation in Push-T and Cube. Probes measure which environmental variables can be recovered from frozen representations; planning evaluations measure task success and computation in flops. Three-level aitch-jepa reaches 73% success on Visual AntMaze, compared with 18% for the flat latent world model. The trend is not universal: deeper models do poorly on Push-T, where short episodes provide fewer valid training clips.
segments.zh: 实验覆盖了FourRoomDistractors和Visual AntMaze中的导航任务，以及Push-T和Cube中的操作任务。探针用于测量从冻结表示中能恢复出哪些环境变量；规划评估则衡量任务成功率和浮点运算量。三级H-JEPA在Visual AntMaze上达到73%的成功率，而扁平的潜在世界模型只有18%。这一趋势并非普遍成立：更深的模型在Push-T上表现不佳，因为短回合提供的有效训练片段更少。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does the evidence show that higher levels consistently learn more abstract features?
segments.zh: 这些证据是否表明，更高层级总能学到更抽象的特征？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No, and that qualification is important. In AntMaze, higher levels make body-state information less recoverable while preserving global position. In FourRoom, the agent’s location remains recoverable while a moving distractor becomes less so. But manipulation datasets show weaker selective abstraction. The authors relate this to the temporal-frequency gap between fast- and slow-changing features: when that gap is larger, the hierarchy more clearly separates them. More levels alone do not guarantee useful abstraction.
segments.zh: 不，这个限定很重要。在AntMaze里，更高的层级会让身体状态信息变得更难恢复，但全局位置仍然保留。在FourRoom里，智能体的位置仍然可以恢复，而一个移动的干扰物则变得更难恢复。但操作类数据集显示出的选择性抽象更弱。作者把这跟快变和慢变特征之间的时间频率差距联系起来：这个差距越大，层级就越能清晰地把它们分开。光靠增加层级并不能保证有用的抽象。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How do the authors separate the benefit of abstraction from the benefit of temporal decomposition?
segments.zh: 作者是如何把抽象带来的好处和时间分解带来的好处区分开的？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: They use two complementary analyses. Scoring an unchanged flat rollout in an upper-level space improves goal matching in AntMaze and FourRoom, supporting a role for abstract goal costs; it does not consistently help in the manipulation tasks. Separately, along expert trajectories, the cost of tracking successive subgoals decreases more consistently than the cost of aiming directly at the final goal over the whole horizon. The latter pattern appears with both aitch-jepa and the shared-space hierarchical model, indicating that temporal decomposition helps on its own.
segments.zh: 他们用了两种互补的分析方法。在高层空间中对一个不变的扁平轨迹打分，能改善AntMaze和FourRoom中的目标匹配，说明抽象目标代价确实有作用；但在操作任务里，这个做法并没有稳定地带来好处。另外，沿着专家轨迹来看，追踪连续子目标的代价比在整个时间跨度上直接瞄准最终目标的代价下降得更稳定。后一种现象在aitch-jepa和共享空间分层模型中都出现了，说明时间分解本身就有帮助。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The real-robot experiments add another practical insight. On diverse robot video, a purely predictive model can focus on stable scene identity rather than robot motion. Adding an inverse-dynamics objective, which predicts actions between consecutive latent states, helps ground the representation in movement. A second level then improves fidelity to recorded expert end-effector paths while reducing planner computation. Because these plans are evaluated offline, however, the result measures path fidelity, not whether a robot succeeds at a physical task.
segments.zh: 真实机器人实验还带来了另一个实用层面的启发。在多样化的机器人视频上，纯预测模型可能更关注稳定的场景身份，而不是机器人运动本身。加入逆动力学目标——即预测相邻隐状态之间的动作——有助于让表征扎根于运动。第二层则能提升对记录下来的专家末端执行器路径的还原度，同时减少规划器的计算量。不过，由于这些规划是在离线条件下评估的，结果衡量的是路径还原度，而不是机器人能否在物理任务中真正成功。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So should we interpret the real-robot result as evidence of deployment readiness?
segments.zh: 那这是否意味着真实机器人实验的结果已经证明可以部署了？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Not yet. The offline fidelity score can reflect graded progress in a simulated drawer task, but the authors find that it is not sufficient to predict binary success in Cube. The work therefore supports the feasibility of learning hierarchical predictors from varied robot video, not reliable closed-loop control on a physical robot. Other limitations include fixed temporal strides, reliance on action labels for the real-robot grounding objective, and evaluation across a limited collection of environments.
segments.zh: 还不能。离线保真度分数可以反映模拟抽屉任务中的阶段性进展，但作者发现它不足以预测Cube任务中的二元成功。因此，这项工作支持的是从多样化机器人视频中学习分层预测器的可行性，而非在物理机器人上实现可靠的闭环控制。其他局限包括固定的时间步长、真实机器人接地目标对动作标签的依赖，以及评估环境集合有限。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The broader contribution is to join two strands: reward-free visual prediction in the spirit of joint-embedding predictive architectures, and hierarchical planning over multiple timescales. Compared with Ada jepa, which adapts a predictive model for goal-reaching, aitch-jepa makes the temporal hierarchy explicit and gives each level its own representation. Compared with the hierarchical world model, it tests whether distinct latent spaces add value beyond temporal decomposition. The results suggest they sometimes do, especially when the data contain clear differences in temporal scale.
segments.zh: 更广泛的贡献在于把两条脉络结合起来：一条是联合嵌入预测架构那种无奖励的视觉预测，另一条是跨多个时间尺度的分层规划。与Ada jepa相比——后者是为达成目标而调整预测模型——aitch-jepa把时间层级显式化，并让每一层拥有自己的表示。与分层世界模型相比，它检验的是不同的潜在空间是否能带来超越时间分解的额外价值。结果表明，有时确实可以，尤其是当数据在时间尺度上存在明显差异时。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: What would be the most important next step for this line of research?
segments.zh: 这条研究路线最重要的下一步是什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A strong next step would test whether learned abstractions support closed-loop physical control across unfamiliar tasks, rather than only offline path comparison. Other promising directions include variable-duration temporal abstractions and high-level goals connected to language. The findings also encourage a careful design question: does the dataset contain predictable structure at multiple timescales, and does the evaluation measure the behavior we ultimately care about? Without those conditions, adding levels may add complexity without adding useful abstraction.
segments.zh: 下一步很值得做的是测试学到的抽象能否支持跨陌生任务的闭环物理控制，而不只是离线路径比较。其他有前景的方向包括可变时长的时间抽象，以及与语言相连的高层目标。这些发现也引出一个需要认真对待的设计问题：数据集是否在多个时间尺度上包含可预测的结构，评估衡量的又是不是我们真正关心的行为？如果这些条件不满足，增加层级可能只会增加复杂度，而不会带来有用的抽象。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The takeaway is that a planning hierarchy can help in two distinct ways: it can shorten long-horizon search through subgoals, and it can provide a different representation for judging progress. Aitch-jepa learns both from action-labelled trajectories, but the benefits depend on the temporal structure of the data and the task. Treat hierarchy as a testable modeling choice, not an automatic advantage. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 结论是，规划层级可以在两个不同方面发挥作用：它可以通过子目标缩短长时程搜索，也可以提供一种不同的表示来判断进展。Aitch-jepa 从带动作标注的轨迹中同时学习这两者，但收益取决于数据和任务的时间结构。要把层级当作一种可检验的建模选择，而不是自动带来的优势。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的 AI 助手或留言评论。
